statements.status_notes: GHSA-ccrj-gw8r-854m is quadratic CPU use in W3CTraceContextPropagator.extract() on tracestate headers; the fix is OpenTelemetry 1.67.0. The 8.4 line ships the Prometheus JMX exporter agent 1.6.0, which bundles OpenTelemetry 1.62.0 under a relocated package prefix; Confluent's common-parent pins that agent and the newest jmx_exporter release, 1.7.0, still bundles 1.65.0. The agent uses OpenTelemetry only to push metrics, and reachability of extract() has not been confirmed.
